name: 6-bromo-MDMA
summary: 6-Bromo-MDMA, also known as 6-bromo-3,4-methylenedioxy-N-methylamphetamine or as 2-bromo-4,5-methylenedioxymethamphetamine (2-Br-4,5-MDMA), is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and MDxx families related to MDMA.

pharmacology.text: It does not appear to be a serotonin releasing agent like MDMA, but instead to be a serotonin reuptake inhibitor like citalopram, and with much greater serotonin transporter (SERT) affinity than MDMA.

uses.text: The drug was encountered as a novel designer drug in Europe in 2014.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Because it blocks serotonin reuptake rather than releasing serotonin, it would not be expected to act like MDMA. Drugs that raise serotonin in this way can cause nausea, headache, sweating and, in serious cases, serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。由於它是阻斷血清素回收而不是釋放血清素，預期它的作用不會像MDMA。以這種方式提高血清素的藥物可能引起噁心、頭痛、出汗，嚴重時可能出現血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。由于它是阻断血清素回收而不是释放血清素，预期它的作用不会像MDMA。以这种方式提高血清素的药物可能引起恶心、头痛、出汗，严重时可能出现血清素症候群。

fact.en: Adding bromine at the 6 position changes the drug completely: instead of releasing serotonin like MDMA, it blocks serotonin reuptake, much as an antidepressant does.
fact.zh: 在第6位加上溴，使這個藥物的作用完全改變：它不像MDMA那樣釋放血清素，而是阻斷血清素回收，作用方式類似抗憂鬱藥。
fact.zhHans: 在第6位加上溴，使这个药物的作用完全改变：它不像MDMA那样释放血清素，而是阻断血清素回收，作用方式类似抗忧郁药。
